w: Swamishri celebrated the festival of Ganesh Chaturthi from 9.00 a.m.

The world needs peace today. People endeavor to achieve this by making weapons and atomic bombs, but one cannot hope to bring peace through them. Peace can be ushered by inspiring good feelings in the hearts of people - that the whole world is our family.
True peace can be attained if one abides by Dharma, has profound faith in God and good feelings for everyone.
When you accomplish one work in this world another ninety-nine arise. So you should not merely hope to worship God when you become free.
We live and indulge in a hectic, jet-set age but we must not forget to accomplish what we have come for. We have come to attain moksha.

Swamishri conveyed his blessings through a telephonic conversation to the Prime Minister of India, Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee who was in Washington. Swamishri also appealed on behalf of the citizens of Gujarat to be of help in solving the case on the Narmada Dam Project.
After Swamishri's morning puja a collective home visit (samuh padhramani) ritual was held. The devotees performed puja and arti of Thakorji and had personal darshan of Swamishri.

In the evening assembly, the L A County District Attorney - Mr.Gil Garcetti, welcomed Swamishri, saying, "It is good that we have a spiritual leader from another country come here to bless us. And it is nice to know that thousands of people respond and listen to him. His message and teachings help to make our lives better and make others' lives better..." The Mayor of Glendora City - Mr.Larry Glenn also spoke glowingly of Swamishri's work. "There are many influences outside but the spiritual influence is the best. I am mostly impressed with your efforts to help the youth. You are setting an example to our youth by saying 'No' to drugs and alcohol. I am deeply impressed by your message."

2009.o: The main programme of the evening satsang assembly was a debate by children and volunteers of Ahmedabad Bal Mandal in which the subject was the Vedic and eternal nature of the Akshar, Purushottam philosophy, Children aged between eight to twelve recited Vedic mantras and shlokas from the Upanishads to show that the Akshar, Purushottam principle is based on our ancient shastras, The 45-minute programme captivated the entire assembly, In conclusion Swamishri praised the performance and blessed the assembly
w: A simple way to god-realization

4 September 2009, Amdavad A teenage devotee asked Swamishri, “How can I realize the true glory of Shriji Maharaj?” “By studying daily (in college) you acquire a degree, similarly, by doing bhajan you will attain realization.” Swamishri gave a simple and guaranteed means to attaining the heights of spirituality, which is otherwise difficult even after doing penance, pilgrimage, charity and meditation.
Responding with great care

7 September 2009, Amdavad Swamishri was attending to his daily correspondence. He was going through the letter of a devotee from a nondescript village near Bhavnagar. He wished to have a new well on his farm. He requested Swamishri to make a mark on the enclosed site plan. Swamishri studied the plan for five minutes and then made a mark. In a similar letter from the town of Ahawa in Dang district a tribal devotee Ðwished to drill a bore well on his farm. He, too, had sent a site plan of his small farm. Swamishri spent five minutes thinking about it and finally made a mark on the plan.

ds.t: "We are the bullocks of Akshar Purushottam"
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to the shrine of Shastriji Maharaj for darshan. Aruni Bhagat recited a saying: "Shastriji Maharaj's principle was that as long as the body lasts, every moment, every second and every single hair of this body should be used only for satsang. We are the bullocks of Akshar Purushottam." Having said this, Swamishri said to the sadhus, parshads and sadhaks sitting for darshan, "We want to become bullocks, don't we?"
"Yes," all the sadhus said together.

So Swamishri immediately said, "We have become bullocks, but everyone will prod us. Even when it is prodded, a bullock never complains. It goes to plough and does whatever it is told. A bullock never says no. In the same way, we too should keep firm."
Atmatrupt Swami had returned from his travels in the month of Shravan. He too told Pramukh Swami Maharaj of an incident in which a devotee had been touched by divinity:

"In Siddhpur there is an enthusiastic volunteer named Jaykishanbhai Thakkar. He had been fully addicted, but through Swamishri's darshan his addictions had gone. Some time ago Mahant Swami was to visit Siddhpur, and Thakorji's meal was to be offered at Jaykishanbhai's home. The enthusiastic Jaykishanbhai thought that since such a senior sadhu was coming and it was very hot, he should have an AC installed for him. He looked for an AC on hire, but could not find one anywhere. So he thought, 'I will buy a new one.'
Being of the middle class, he was making such arrangements for the sadhus. Meanwhile a friend of his came and asked, 'What are you doing?'
Jaykishanbhai told him everything. So he said, 'I have a Muslim friend who repairs ACs. Let us go to him. We will ask him to give you an AC for one day.'
The two of them went to the Muslim friend, told him everything and said, 'I will pay whatever the hire is, but please install an AC in my house for one day.'
The Muslim man asked, 'For whom are you doing all this?'
Then Jaykishanbhai said, 'The sadhus of Pramukh Swami are coming to my home, so I am doing this.'
Hearing this, the Muslim man said, 'If it is for Pramukh Swami, I do not want any money. I will install the AC and take it back at my own expense.'
Jaykishanbhai said, 'How do you have such great feeling?'

The Muslim man said, 'I have great respect for Pramukh Swami. He is a holy soul. When there was a terrorist attack on Akshardham, the way he appealed for calm saved the Muslims of Gujarat. That has touched me deeply.'"
In this context, Ghanshyamcharan Swami (Ghanshyam Bapa) said, "You have drawn everyone's attention. Everyone says 'Bapa, Bapa'. What magic have you worked?"
Swamishri said, "Because Bapa (you) keep travelling around, the work gets done. The sadhus travel, they go from village to village, and that is why the work gets done."
Bhadresh Swami said, "But he is talking about you!"
Swamishri said, "Let us talk about the sadhus. Do the sadhus do any less work? They went from village to village, wading through mud."
Narayancharan Swami said, "You too have travelled everywhere in the same way!"
Swamishri said, "We have travelled through mud too and we have travelled everywhere, but how hard the sadhus work now!"
Bhadresh Swami said, "When we went to meet the Shankaracharya of Kanchipuram, he said, 'I look at Pramukh Swami's photo every day. At this age he still travels.'"

ds.t: Across the ocean of worldly life
w: Today was Mahant Swami Maharaj's birthday by the English date. It was also the festival of Jal Jhilani Ekadashi. So Thakorji had been placed on a boat shaped throne. In this connection the sadhus prayed to Swamishri, "Please carry us across the ocean of worldly life."
Then Swamishri said, "We will certainly, certainly carry you across. Since we have met Maharaj and met Swami, we have already crossed the ocean of worldly life!"
In these words of Swamishri shone the power of the mighty helmsman across the ocean of worldly life.

Today, after performing the murti pratishtha (consecration) of Ghanshyam Maharaj, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to a smaller stage prepared a little distance away. Showering blessings, he said, "Ishwarcharan Swami does everything. With him are five other sadhus: Doctor Swami, Kothari Bapa, Tyagvallabh Swami, Viveksagar Swami and Ghanshyam Bapa. They are all strong, so our work goes on. They have all understood it as their duty and taken my burden on themselves. And on top of that, they behave in such a way that their own names never come up. No one has the power to break the unity there is among us." Everyone greeted these words of Swamishri with tremendous applause.
Swamishri said, "Guaranteed! They are all dear to Bhagwan. They are dear to Yogi Bapa. They are dear to Pramukh Swami Maharaj."
Then everyone requested, "Swami! Just as Yogi Bapa used to give blessings with both hands raised, please today also give blessings with both hands raised."

Swamishri laughed. He was a little hesitant, but since everyone requested so much, he raised both hands and blessed everyone. In an instant, hundreds of pictures of this wonderful memory were captured on camera.
Having pleased everyone, Swamishri went to his residence.
Today, while Mahant Swami Maharaj was eating, a child called out loudly, "Please eat the jalebi."
We know that Swamishri does not have much liking for sweets, but because the child said it, Swamishri immediately took a piece of jalebi and ate it!
The child's father said, "He loves jalebi very much, so when he saw jalebi in your thal he asked you to eat it."
Hearing this, Swamishri immediately had jalebi brought for all the children.
Normally, by Swamishri's instruction, all the children are given chocolate as prasad right at the start of Swamishri's meal, but today this was special prasad.
Arrangements were made to bring the jalebi, but now see how deeply Swamishri thinks...
Swamishri said to the sadhus, "Do not give this jalebi to everyone like the chocolate. Give it only to those who like it."

This last sentence was truly very precious. Swamishri understands that today's generation, and especially the new generation born on foreign soil, might not like jalebi. So it is better if the jalebi prasad is given according to taste!
On such occasions we realise why a "Generation Gap" never arises between the great sadhu and children and youths!

Giving a special report on the Edison mandal, the sadhus said, "Here, every Wednesday, everyone must hold ghar sabha (family assembly). Nothing else is planned on that day, only ghar sabha. And so that everyone remembers, the volunteers send a ghar sabha reminder on Tuesday night in some new and creative way." Everyone wished that Swamishri would also write something like this for them.
Swamishri wrote in English: "Happy Gharsabha = (is equal to) SAMP."
That is, "A joyful ghar sabha means unity."

As Mahant Swami Maharaj was coming onto the stage of the Expo Hall, the sadhus introduced a devotee named Scott Reddy. He is a director of an Australian company called Flight Centre. He was overwhelmed on having Swamishri's darshan. He had a question in his mind, which he asked Swamishri:
"I saw your schedule. You wake up so early. You do a lot of work. Where do you get the energy from? What is your source of energy?"
Swamishri immediately pointed upwards and said, "God!"
Scott was completely satisfied.
Scott naturally experienced that it is Bhagwan himself who is working, dwelling within him.

ds.t: It is early, let us write a letter
w: The whole day's programme had been packed. So the attendant sadhus seated Mahant Swami Maharaj on his bed so that he would now go to sleep. Swamishri glanced at the clock. It was 9.38. He said, "It is early. Let us write a letter."

Swamishri, who lives following in the footsteps of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, got up from the bed. Sitting on the sofa, he finished one letter. Looking at the clock again, it was exactly 10.00. The satisfaction on Swamishri's face was saying, "Now it is just right!"
In Swamishri's mind, he should not sleep even one second more than needed. This is his dedication to work.
